Name: in_Valuation_Date
Description: Common valuation date for every security and fund
Rationale: Set by 00-main to the latest date for which prices; NAVs and holdings reconcile (spec <valuation_date>)

Name: in_Price_Date
Description: Single market-price date used for all compared securities
Rationale: Spec <data_retrieval>: one price date; never mix dates silently

Name: in_Global_Case
Description: Default fundamental case for Fundamental Assumption Scenario mode

Name: in_Global_Price_Shock_Pct
Description: Market-wide price shock applied in Market Price Shock mode

Name: in_Default_MoS
Description: Default required margin of safety for target purchase prices
Rationale: Placeholder preference; replace with your own. Not derived from data

Name: in_Risk_Free_Rate
Description: 10-year Government of India security yield at in_Valuation_Date
Rationale: To be sourced by 01-data from RBI/CCIL; blank keeps cost of equity blank

Name: in_Equity_Risk_Premium
Description: Indian equity risk premium
Rationale: To be set by 02-valuation with a documented rationale; never defaulted silently

Name: in_TV_Share_Warn
Description: Terminal-value share above which a valuation is flagged WARNING

Name: in_Coverage_Warn
Description: Equity valuation coverage below which fair NAV is WARNING

Name: in_Coverage_Fail
Description: Equity valuation coverage below which fair NAV is FAIL

Name: in_Recon_Tolerance_Pct
Description: Max relative gap between computed and reported scheme net assets

Name: in_Weight_Sum_Tol
Description: Tolerance on disclosed weights summing to 100%

Name: in_Holdings_Stale_Days
Description: Holdings older than this vs in_Price_Date are STALE
Rationale: Monthly disclosures arrive ~10 days after month end

Name: in_Price_Stale_Days
Description: Price observations older than this vs in_Price_Date are STALE

Name: in_Financials_Stale_Days
Description: Latest reported results older than this vs in_Valuation_Date are STALE
Rationale: SEBI LODR Reg 33: quarterly results are due within 45 days of quarter end; 90 + 45 days means a newer quarter should exist (contract §3.1b)

Name: in_Anchor_Max_Age_Days
Description: Anchor balance sheet older than this vs in_Valuation_Date is FAIL
Rationale: Annual audited results are due within 60 days of fiscal year end; 365 + 60 days means a newer balance sheet should exist (contract §3.1b)

Name: in_Interim_EPS_Dev_Warn
Description: Relative gap between reported interim EPS and pro-rata year-1 forecast EPS that flags the forecast for review
Rationale: Contract §3.1a forecast-update check; a governance threshold not a market fact

Name: in_Peer_Min_N
Description: Minimum valid peers before a peer median is used without WARNING

Name: in_Clean_Surplus_Tol
Description: Tolerance for the clean-surplus capital retention check

Name: in_Default_TC_Pct
Description: Transaction cost for hypothetical trades
Rationale: Blank until entered; hypothetical costs are user inputs (spec method four)

Name: in_Hypo_Capital_INR
Description: Capital for the hypothetical rebalanced portfolio
